title: finding(components): `data-table`'s header context menu offers Sort ascending / descending on a column declared `sortable: false` — the menu gates on the table-wide `sortingEnabled` only, while the header click also reads `col.sortable`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a declared key one path does not read (class b), read from source with a lit control. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the objectui#10657 dev report and the at-tier contract review of PR objectui#10725 (merged as `9c78ebe`). Both confirmed it at source and left it out of that card. The seat re-read it on objectui `origin/main` `9c78ebe3a`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## Fact

- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:1316-1317`: `isColumnSortable = sortingEnabled && col.sortable !== false && !isMaskedColumnKey(…)`. The header's cursor, click and indicator read it.
- `:2896`: the header context menu renders Sort ascending / Sort descending under `sortingEnabled && !isMaskedColumnKey(…)`. There is no `col.sortable` read.
- ⇒ A column authored `sortable: false` can be sorted from its header's context menu.
- The contract, `TableColumn.sortable` in `@object-ui/types`: 「Whether column is sortable」 (`@default true`).

**Lit control:** the header click on the same column is refused (`isColumnSortable`).

Read from source, not probed.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The menu's sort entries read `isColumnSortable(col)`, the one predicate the header uses.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues: `data-table header context menu sort ascending descending ignores column sortable false` ⇒ objectui#5845, objectui#5827, objectui#3950 and objectui#4243 (closed; other sort defects). None covers the context menu and `sortable: false`, and the hits show the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `context menu sortable false` · `data-table header menu sort ignores sortable` · `column menu sort non-sortable column`
